items.headline: What will be deciding factor for Florida vs. Georgia?
items.description: With the No. 17 Gators set to face the No. 3 Bulldogs, the SEC Nation crew breaks down the components on both sides of the ball that could decide the matchup.

items.headline: Doering, Watson draw up plans for success ahead of Georgia vs. Florida
items.description: SEC Network's Benjamin Watson puts together the perfect plan for the Bulldogs to be successful as Chris Doering emphasizes how the Gators can hold off their tough defense.

items.headline: Benjamin Watson dissects Georgia's mindset vs. Florida
items.description: SEC Network's Watson joins The Paul Finebaum Show and explains how the No. 3 Bulldogs are approaching their rivalry matchup against the No. 17 Gators coming off a defeat.

items.headline: How consistent change of college football landscape impacts SEC
items.description: Matt Barrie joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss how continuous changes across the college football world has impacted the SEC as he previews the Florida vs. Georgia matchup.

items.headline: Tim Tebow reminisces on his time as a Gator, dissects Florida vs. UGA
items.description: Tebow shares stories about the significance of the Florida vs. Georgia rivalry through his perspective as a former player, then breaks down Saturday's keys to success.

items.headline: Roman Harper gives an interesting way Florida can win vs. Georgia
items.description: SEC Nation's Harper chimes in on The Paul Finebaum Show to explain how an unorthodox offensive approach could help the No. 17 Gators beat the No. 3 Bulldogs.
